title: Internal: recording an in-window class booking cancellation for Group Fitness Class Passes
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the capability and calling contract of the tool used to record that a member cancelled a previously booked class with enough advance notice.

## Situation of use and capability
When a member cancels a previously booked class with enough advance notice, this tool records the cancellation and refunds the credit that booking spent back to the pack's balance at no charge.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): cancel_class_booking_in_window_11da7e9b.

## Parameters
- class_pass_id: the reference number of the class-credit pack the cancelled booking was made against.
- class_session_id: the reference number of the specific scheduled class session being cancelled.
- class_type: the studio class type of the cancelled session — one of yoga, cycling, hiit, pilates, strength, or dance.
- club_id: the reference number of the club location where the cancelled class was held.
- credits_delta: the signed whole number of class credits being refunded back to the pack's balance by this cancellation, always a positive whole number matching the credits originally spent on the booking now being cancelled.

## Return
On success, cancel_class_booking_in_window_11da7e9b returns a confirmation naming the new booking-history entry, echoing the class_pass_id refunded to, and stating the credits_delta credited and that the amount_usd charged is 0 (an in-window cancellation is free). No error, review or correction behavior beyond this confirmation is defined for this tool.
